subject: Action Required: Provider Enrollment Application Update
body:
Dear Credentialing Team,

We have completed the initial review of the provider enrollment application submitted on behalf of:

Provider Name: Demo CAQH-Provider
NPI: 9999999991
Application Reference: AVL-DEMO-2026-8442

Unfortunately, the application could not be approved at this time. Our credentialing committee has identified the following deficiency:

The attached signature page (Form 3.2 — Practitioner Acknowledgement) was missing the practitioner's wet-ink or eSignature on the line indicated by the highlighted X. We require a signed copy before we can advance the application to network-effective status.

Please resubmit the corrected form within 30 days of this notice via the Availity portal. Once received, your application will return to the active review queue.

If you have any questions, please contact us at credentialing@availity-demo.com.

Regards,
Availity (DEMO) Provider Credentialing Team
